title: Your first trade for Wednesday, December 19
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Lowe's .
Brian Kelly was a buyer of Altria .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of the Utilities ETF .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Target .
